name: Voice Ops Settings
description: Configuration for Voice Ops integrations and call settings

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Twilio credentials must be configured in Twilio Settings before enabling

fields.label: Call Buffer (minutes before departure)
fields.description: How many minutes before scheduled departure to trigger the checklist call

fields.label: Default Pre-Departure Template
fields.description: Template used for auto-triggered pre-departure calls

fields.label: Max Recording Length (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum duration for a single answer recording. Hard cap regardless of silence.

fields.label: Default Response Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Seconds of silence before moving to the next question. Can be overridden per question.

fields.label: Default Post-Trip Template
fields.description: Template used for auto-triggered post-arrival calls. Leave blank to disable post-trip calls.

fields.label: Post-Trip Buffer (minutes after completion)
fields.description: How many minutes after trip completion to allow triggering the post-trip call

fields.label: Sarvam Model
fields.description: saaras:v3 supports translate/transcribe modes. saarika:v2.5 is legacy (transcribe only).

fields.label: Sarvam Mode
fields.description: translate = any Indian language to English. transcribe = keep original language. verbatim = exact speech.

fields.label: Default Language
fields.options:
unknown
hi-IN
ta-IN
te-IN
kn-IN
en-IN
fields.description: Set to 'unknown' for auto-detection (recommended with saaras:v3)

fields.label: Low Confidence Threshold
fields.description: Transcripts below this confidence score will be flagged for review

fields.label: Enable Escalation Notifications
fields.description: Send in-app and email notifications when blockers or critical issues are detected

fields.label: Escalation Email Group
fields.description: Email Group to notify on escalations. Leave blank for in-app notifications only.

fields.label: Yes/No Synonyms
fields.description: Add language-specific words that mean Yes or No. These are merged with built-in defaults.
